Changed: Rebuild LeAgent around a portable core, provider adapters, and a coding application layer.
Adopt a single le-agent distribution and a deliberately incompatible session/configuration schema.
Execute tool batches in parallel only when every known tool in the batch allows parallel execution.
New: Add Tavily-backed web_search with keyed and best-effort keyless modes.

Removed: Remove native Anthropic and Google provider implementations.
